subject: English
passage: During her 2019 residency in Kyoto, ceramicist Clara Maxwell spent nine months studying the craft traditions of the region, including its many ______ To record her observations, Maxwell gave working names like Moonwell and Thistle to some of the smaller yet distinctive pieces she encountered in local collections.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of apostrophes with plural nouns. No apostrophes are needed in 'vases and bowls' because both words are simple plural nouns serving as the object of the preposition 'including.' Apostrophes would incorrectly signal possession or contraction, neither of which is appropriate in this context.
